findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "claim" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: skill, search_tools, schedule, list_team, claim · Private data: skill, search_tools, request_tool, report_detour, join_team, runner_key · Public sink: skill, search_tools, schedule, invite_teammate, list_team, team_invite_link, team_links, join_team, start, claim · Destructive: skill, schedule, runner_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: skill, search_tools, schedule, list_team, claim · Private data: skill, search_tools, request_tool, report_detour, join_team, runner_key · Public sink: skill, search_tools, schedule, invite_teammate, list_team, team_invite_link, team_links, join_team, start, claim · Destructive: skill, schedule, runner_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
